blog_title: Benchmark Beaters Weekly: 190 Stocks Beating Their Benchmarks (November 27, 2026)
email_subject: Benchmark Beaters: DRX & REGN lead 190 stocks beating the market
preview_text: 32 Canadian and 158 U.S. names at six-month relative highs. Full table and charts inside.
intro: The latest Benchmark Beaters screen (as of November 27, 2026) found 190 Canadian and U.S. stocks outperforming their benchmarks, each hitting a new six-month relative high in the last five trading days.

In Canada, 32 stocks made a fresh six-month high relative to the TSX Composite, 8 of them new to the list this week. ADF Group Inc. (DRX) leads with a +109% six-month return, and Industrials is the most represented sector with 9 names.

In the U.S., 158 stocks made a fresh six-month high relative to the S&P 500, 8 of them new to the list this week. Regeneron Pharmaceuticals Inc. (REGN) leads with a +66% six-month return, and Health Care is the most represented sector with 31 names.
